scenarios.title: Blocking Chain
scenarios.forcedCondition: Open transactions acquire deterministic locks and named database signals order the dependent sessions until an observable blocking chain exists.
scenarios.synchronization: FWK-006 named signals; launch delays are process-start hints only.
evidence: runtime matrix marks Docker and Podman, SQL Server 2019/2022/2025, two repetitions
problem manifest executes HEAD, MIDDLE, LEAF and OBSERVER concurrently
comparison manifest is a separate two-session phase
knownLimits: Tests/Lab/performance-lab-matrix.json currently declares sessions=3 although Sessions/problem.json contains four concurrent sessions; the executable manifest is authoritative for scenario design

scenarios.title: SARGability
scenarios.forcedCondition: Equivalent predicates run against deterministic indexed data in seek-compatible and non-SARGable forms.
evidence: runtime matrix marks Docker and Podman, SQL Server 2019/2022/2025, two repetitions

scenarios.title: Statistics Anatomy
scenarios.forcedCondition: A fixed data distribution and explicitly generated statistics create a known histogram and density state.
evidence: runtime matrix marks Docker and Podman, SQL Server 2019/2022/2025, two repetitions

scenarios.title: Controlled Spill
scenarios.forcedCondition: A controlled cardinality and memory-grant mismatch produces spill evidence under a defined resource profile.
knownLimits: spill characteristics may vary by build and adaptive-feature state; assertions must test evidence rather than exact spill volume
evidence: runtime matrix marks fresh instance, Docker and Podman, SQL Server 2019/2022/2025, two repetitions

scenarios.title: Plan Properties
scenarios.forcedCondition: A deterministic out-of-range statistics state produces plan-wide and operator-level evidence before and after targeted statistics maintenance.
evidence: runtime matrix and current status report repeated validation on SQL Server 2019, 2022 and 2025

scenarios.title: Rebinds, Rewinds and Performance Spool
scenarios.forcedCondition: A deterministic correlated access pattern produces observable outer references, rebinds, rewinds and an optimizer-selected performance spool with a controlled contrast.
evidence: runtime matrix and current status report repeated validation on SQL Server 2019, 2022 and 2025

scenarios.title: Catch-all, OPTION RECOMPILE and parameterized dynamic SQL
scenarios.forcedCondition: A deterministic skewed data set and controlled compilation order contrast catch-all predicates, recompilation and safely parameterized dynamic SQL.

scenarios.title: Neutral client and session context
scenarios.forcedCondition: Equivalent query text executes under explicitly controlled session SET options and client-independent connection settings.
